lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots forming roughly parallel horizontal rows along the longitudinal axis, with the highest concentration observed in the mid-lateral region posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of spots, creating a rectilinear pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the flank, each displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and a dark shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, high-luminance circular spots bounded within the dorsal fin silhouette, primarily concentrated along the posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A satellite telemetry tag is visible, anchored at the anterior base of the first dorsal fin with a trailing tether and dark oblong transmitter. A secondary smaller tag or biopsy anchor is visible on the mid-flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae swimming in the ventral region and a dark, raised nodule or parasitic attachment point on the upper flank near the dorsal ridge.
